title: Restriction of the canonical single-complex stalk condition
statement: Let $X',X,S',S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with a cartesian square $g':X'\to X$, $f':X'\to S'$, $f:X\to S$, $g:S'\to S$. Let $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, $K'\in D(\mathcal O_{X'})$ [def-pc-derived-category] and $\phi:L(g')^*K\to K'$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] satisfy the canonical stalk condition [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. For any open $U\subset X$, write $j:U\to X$, $P=X'\times_X U$, $p:P\to X'$ and $q:P\to U$. Set $K_U=Lj^*K$, $K'_U=Lp^*K'$, and let $\phi_U:Lq^*K_U\to K'_U$ be the composite of the canonical pullback composition comparison for $q,j$, the identification $qj=pg'$, the inverse composition comparison for $p,g'$, and $Lp^*\phi$ [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Then the stalk condition holds for $U,P,S,S'$, $jf,pf',g,q$, $K_U,K'_U,\phi_U$. No affine, quasi-coherent, compactness or boundedness hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Take an original coordinate presentation c using nonempty_coordinates. Restrict its K-flat source complex and target complex along U.ι and pullback.fst. Exact restriction preserves K-flatness; the exact derived restriction agrees with derived pullback. Restrict the representative isomorphisms, and use underived pullback composition to transport the restriction of c.t to a chain map. Compatibility of the universal counits gives its represents equation and invertibility of the pullback counit. This constructs restricted coordinates cU. Restriction identifies the stalk complexes via the actual local-ring isomorphisms.

Use pullback composition and the natural tensor-pullback stalk isomorphisms to identify the restricted coefficient map with phi on every stalk. Functoriality of derived tensor and homology identifies their localized tensor cohomology comparisons. A change of K-flat representative gives quasi-isomorphic tensor representatives; the equation representing phi makes the induced cohomology arrow independent of the coordinate presentation.

At every restricted point and degree, the coordinate stalk comparison in cU is conjugate to the original one in c, so the given original stalk condition makes it invertible. Apply isIso_stalkComparison_iff_coordinates within the restricted square to pass from cU to each arbitrary restricted coordinate presentation d. This proves the universally quantified restricted stalk condition, including the vacuous empty-open case.

theorem singleComplexStalkCondition_open
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (h_stalk : SingleComplexBaseChange.StalkCondition f f' g g' sq K K' φ)
    (U : X.Opens)
    (sqU : IsPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') (U.ι ≫ f) g) :
    let φU :=
      ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))))
        (pullback.snd g' U.ι) U.ι).hom.app K ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj K)
        (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := U.ι)).symm) ≫
      ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))))
        (pullback.fst g' U.ι) g').inv.app K ≫
      (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).map φ
    SingleComplexBaseChange.StalkCondition (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
      g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sqU ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)
      ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).obj K') φU
